bugfix: Fix the booking cancellation bug across bookings.py, seats.py, and ledger.py. BookingService.book(event, customer, seats) reserves a positive integer number of seats and charges 25 per seat, returning a booking id. BookingService.cancel(booking_id) returns True on first cancellation, restores seats and refunds exactly once; subsequent or unknown cancellations return False. Booking failures from insufficient capacity raise ValueError without charging or reducing capacity. Keep existing public method signatures.
feature: Implement a reliable batch transfer in bank.py, accounts.py and transfers.py. Bank.transfer_many(transfers) accepts a list of (source, destination, positive integer amount). Validate every transfer and all account ids first; reject invalid amounts or unknown accounts with ValueError. If any transfer would overdraw at its point in the batch, raise ValueError and leave all balances unchanged. Otherwise apply transfers in order and return the final balances as a dict. Preserve Bank.balance(account_id) and Bank.transfer(source, destination, amount).
refactor: Add optional case_insensitive=False support to search_documents(query, documents, case_insensitive=False) in search.py and index.py. Documents are dicts with id and text. Preserve the original exact substring behavior and original document order when False. When True, perform Unicode casefolded substring matching. Do not mutate the documents, and preserve existing build_index(documents) and find_matches(index, query) behavior for existing callers. Empty query matches all documents.
